name: Spore Button
inscription: A little cap of old stone. Hold it near the ground and the ground remembers rain.

name: Mossbound Charm
inscription: Moss has grown over it and never let go. Where it rests, mushrooms gather.

name: Mistcap Idol
inscription: A small figure with a mushroom hat, worn smooth by mist.

name: Mycelium Crown
inscription: Fine threads run through it like roots. Bury it and they reach out.

name: Heart of the Ring
inscription: Every fairy ring began around something like this.

name: Lantern Pebble
inscription: A pebble that keeps a little light inside, even at noon.

name: Foxfire Token
inscription: It glows the way old wood glows on a damp night.

name: Glowworm Locket
inscription: Something small and patient shines inside it.

name: Moonlit Prism
inscription: It holds on to moonlight long after the moon has gone.

name: Star of the Hollow
inscription: Once, the whole wood was lit by this.

name: Petal Stone
inscription: A stone with a flower pressed into it, still faintly sweet.

name: Bud Brooch
inscription: A carved bud that looks as if it is about to open.

name: Blossom Seal
inscription: Flowers lean towards it, the way they lean towards the sun.

name: Garland Crown
inscription: Woven petals that never wilted.

name: First Flower
inscription: They say every meadow is a memory of this one bloom.

name: Leaf Token
inscription: A leaf turned to stone, still green at the edges.

name: Fern Knot
inscription: A tight curl of fern, waiting to unroll.

name: Greenwood Torc
inscription: Grass grows tall wherever it has lain.

name: Thicket Crown
inscription: Woven from twigs that are still, somehow, growing.

name: Root of the Old Wood
inscription: A piece of the first tree. The forest still knows it.

name: Crystal Shard
inscription: A sliver of crystal that hums when you hold it to your ear.

name: Geode Heart
inscription: A small geode, cracked just enough to let the light in.

name: Prism Shard
inscription: It splits the light into colours no one has names for.

name: Singing Crystal
inscription: It hums a low note, and other crystals answer.

name: Heartcrystal
inscription: The crystal everything else that glitters was grown from.

name: Mist Charm
inscription: A pale charm, cool to the touch, wrapped in a breath of mist.

name: Fae Bell
inscription: A tiny bell that rings only when no one is listening.

name: Rootwood Totem
inscription: Old roots carved into a face that seems to be dreaming.

name: Veil Lantern
inscription: A lantern for walking between this wood and an older one.

name: Eye of the Old Forest
inscription: It has watched this clearing for a very long time.
